title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff thrashing and regional failover load-shedding
author: Aisha Patel
description: Hotfix to address a production regression where the SLO enforcer entered backoff thrashing during cross-region failover and burst load, causing sustained elevated error rates and degraded latency. Root cause: a race between concurrent backoff state updates and token-bucket refill logic when failover triggers rapid priority reordering, which allowed the enforcer to repeatedly open/close circuit breakers in short intervals. This change serializes backoff state mutations via a lightweight update queue, introduces a region-aware cooldown window to avoid immediate failback flip-flopping, increases the load-shedding grace window to reduce oscillation during short bursts, and tightens priority-queue ordering to guarantee deterministic dequeue order for the SLO path. Added targeted unit and integration tests that reproduce the thrash scenario and validated behavior under synthetic cross-region failover traffic. Also added observability: new metric slo_enforcer.backoff.thrash_count and an alert rule tweak to avoid noisy paging during transient oscillation. This is a hotfix branch intended to be cherry-picked to the 2026-02-15 release branch if approved. See commits and file list for details.
commits: serialize backoff updates via single-writer update queue (backoff_manager.go)
add region-aware cooldown and failback guard (queue_manager.go)
increase load-shedding grace window from 200ms to 500ms and make configurable (slo/config.go)
add deterministic priority-queue ordering and tests (tests/backoff_thrash_test.go)
review_comments: Miguel Torres: The change to serialize updates looks good but can you add a microbenchmark for the queue under high QPS to ensure we don't regress latency?
Aisha Patel: Added a benchmark and linked results to the PR description. 99th p99 latency impact is < 0.5ms in our local perf harness.
Claire Zhang: Can you clarify the cooldown window rationale and why 10s vs 30s? Also please make the value configurable via slo/config with sane defaults.

Aisha Patel: We tuned with synthetic traffic; 10s was sufficient to avoid flip-flop in most failure windows in our canary. Made the value configurable and documented the tradeoffs in scripts/rollout_playbook.md.
Devon Reed: CI flake on integration test on first run, re-ran CI and all checks passed. Approving pending a squash merge.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff behavior to prevent thrashing during regional failover and burst traffic. Prevents repeated circuit breaker open/close cycles, reduces noisy alerts, and improves availability during failover. Configurable cooldown and load-shed grace window added.
summary: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff thrashing by serializing updates, adding region cooldown, and increasing load-shedding grace window; includes tests and metrics.
